I have farmed this land in the North East for many decades, and I know what my soil needs. I will spread some chemical fertilizer because the land has grown tired, but I can only afford a small amount for this plot. I will also add manure from my animals, as mixing it with fertilizer gives me a better sorghum harvest. My family and I will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves, and I will sow the seeds I saved from last season because I trust them to grow in these dry conditions.
